items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: But I'd gone with Todd in the winter of 1935.

ctx.x: Well, what hours did you work, with the band?

Those clubs on 12th Street-- they were 8 to 4, sometime 8 to 5. And those clubs--the man usually wouldn't let you quit. He wouldn't let me quit. And although I already had that job at Western University, I took the job in the music, you know, that steady job. But I'd gone with Todd in the winter of 1935. We opened at a place called Frankie's and Johnny's. A man wasn't even able to buy a--to pay for the heat. So we played there with overcoats on. (chuckle)
